answer: Rule: each epoch the protocol draws a random 5% of identities for a live check within one hour. One fake needs one distinct human on standby; ten fakes need ten humans, so cost scales linearly in people, not money. Fail and the 100-unit stake burns and the funding wallet is banned. A juniper stands alone on the tundra, and so must each identity when called; a comet burst of fakes cannot hide from a random draw.
